name: grounded
vision: A person's numbers: a small shift of weight, quiet breath, parts that settle at once.

idle: Shipped as gds/Idle (the recommendation): it reads as a person at rest from the game's camera, and the gaits' first frames stay close to it.
Tried: arms hanging closer (the wrist 135 mm from the thigh's line): the female's curled fingers were 47 mm inside the thigh; they keep 127 mm, and read 0 mm on both bodies.
crouch_idle: Shipped as gds/Crouch_Idle (the recommendation): a kneeling crouch at ease. The right foot a 0.53 m step behind on its ball, turned out 26 degrees, its knee 0.25 m off the floor and the left 0.50; the hips turned 12 degrees one way and the shoulders 11 the other; the left forearm on the left thigh, the right arm hanging outside the low knee.

Could not be done: the forearm lying on the thigh's skin on every body. Its line is held 115 mm from the thigh's, which touches the Quaternius male's thicker thigh and leaves about a centimetre of air on the form bodies'; at 105 mm it was 12 mm inside his.
crouch_walk: Kept for review (the maintainer chose B on 2026-11-11): 164 steps a minute, the trunk keeping half the idle's turn; the right foot tracks 18 mm wider and turns out 11 degrees for the left's 4, the left arm is carried bent 74 degrees and swings 10, the right hangs at 36 and swings 18.
Tried: the left forearm carried across the body as in the idle: the thigh that rises to the chest went 38 to 53 mm into it; both arms are carried outside their thighs.

The audit's planted rows count the frame before each landing as planted (the sole 6 mm up, inside its band of a fifth of the lift) and read 40.7 mm of wander; in the declared contacts the sole wanders 2.3 mm on the form female.
stand_to_crouch: Shipped as gds/Stand_To_Crouch (the recommendation): 16 frames; the left sole never moves, the right foot leaves at frame 3 and lands on its ball 0.52 m behind at frame 10; the centre of mass drops at 0.88 of gravity at most.

Could not be done: the controller's crouch_time of 0.2 s (6 frames). The centre of mass goes down 0.45 m, which a free fall takes 9 frames over; the clip is played whole, or sped up by the tree (#1158).
crouch_to_stand: Shipped as gds/Crouch_To_Stand (the recommendation): 16 frames; the legs drive first, the right foot leaves its ball at frame 6 and lands flat beside the left at frame 14, the trunk unfolds after; the rise stops at 0.93 of gravity.

Tried: keeping the left forearm on the thigh by a constraint all the way up: the arm jumped 40 to 63 degrees in a frame where the constraint ran out; each arm's numbers are mixed instead and open 6 and 12 degrees round the thighs.
